name: Hugging Face
tagline: Hub for open models, datasets and Spaces
description: Hugging Face hosts open models, datasets and apps (Spaces), with a PRO account, Team and Enterprise plans plus pay-as-you-go compute and storage.
features: Free CPU Basic and ZeroGPU Spaces
strengths: Free tier for CPU Basic and ZeroGPU
Egress and CDN included at no extra cost
limitations: Compute is billed hourly and can be costly for large GPUs

free.details: Listed free options: CPU Basic (2 vCPU, 16 GB) and ZeroGPU (dynamic).

api.summary: Spaces: CPU Upgrade $0.03/hr, Nvidia T4 small $0.40/hr, A100 large $2.50/hr. Inference Endpoints start at $0.033/hr (GPU e.g. H100 1x $4.50/hr). Storage per TB per month: base $12 public / $18 private, with lower tiers at higher volumes.

keyFeature: A hub for open models, datasets and Spaces apps

profile.headline: The open hub for models, datasets and AI apps

capabilities.title: Find and use open models
capabilities.text: The Model Hub hosts models for LLM, text, vision and audio tasks, each with a model card describing limitations and biases.

capabilities.title: Share and explore datasets
capabilities.text: More than 500,000 public datasets, with Data Studio to look inside them in the browser and streaming for very large ones.

capabilities.title: Host a demo app
capabilities.text: Spaces hosts interactive ML demos built with Gradio, Streamlit, static HTML or Docker.

capabilities.title: Call models through an API
capabilities.text: Inference Providers offers a serverless API for programmatic access to models.

featureCards.name: Git-based repositories
featureCards.text: Versioning, commit history, diffs and branches for models, datasets and Spaces.

featureCards.name: ZeroGPU Spaces
featureCards.text: GPU power for demos, provided dynamically only when needed.

featureCards.name: Storage Buckets
featureCards.text: S3-like object storage for large mutable files such as training checkpoints and logs.

featureCards.name: Organizations
featureCards.text: Group accounts, manage repositories and set roles for companies, universities and non-profits.

featureCards.name: Security controls
featureCards.text: User access tokens, access control for organisations, commit signing and malware scanning.

featureCards.name: Agent tooling
featureCards.text: The docs list a Hugging Face CLI for AI agents and an MCP server.

audienceDetail.text: The Hub is described as the reference platform for open ML.
Organizations let them group accounts and manage their work.
Hugging Face for Classrooms supports collaborative organisations for students.
The Hub also works as a collaboration platform for internal and private teams.

scenarios.title: Publish a model with a model card
scenarios.text: Upload the model and document its limitations and biases.

scenarios.title: Showcase a project in a Space
scenarios.text: Build a demo app to show stakeholders or to grow your ML portfolio.

scenarios.title: Stream a very large dataset
scenarios.text: Access data that does not fit on your computer without downloading all of it.

scenarios.title: Store training checkpoints
scenarios.text: Keep logs and intermediate files in a Storage Bucket.

gettingStarted.text: Sign up on the Hub; the docs ask you to read the Code of Conduct and Content Guidelines.
Browse models, datasets and Spaces to see what the community has shared.
Follow the Models, Datasets or Spaces documentation to publish your own.
Create or join an organisation to share repositories and set access.
